     MAPA — żeby dodać punkt, dopisz wiersz do tablicy `stops` poniżej:
     {lat, lon, place, type: "talk" albo "visit", events: ["Rok — nazwa"]}
     Współrzędne wygodnie sprawdzić w Google Maps (prawy klik → kopiuj).
     ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->

<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js"></script>

<div id="talkmap" class="talkmap"></div>

<script>
(function () {
  const stops = [
    {lat: 60.1699, lon: 24.9384, place: "Helsinki, Finland", type: "talk",
     events: ["2026 — 16th Int. Conference on New Ideas in Management, Economics and Accounting"]},
    {lat: 37.9838, lon: 23.7275, place: "Athens, Greece", type: "talk",
     events: ["2026 — 10th Int. Conference on Advanced Research in Management, Business and Finance"]},
    {lat: 52.2053, lon: 0.1218, place: "Cambridge, United Kingdom", type: "talk",
     events: ["2025 — 9th Int. Conference on Business, Management and Finance"]},
    {lat: 51.5074, lon: -0.1278, place: "London, United Kingdom", type: "talk",
     events: ["2025 — Int. Conference on Economics, Finance &amp; Business"]},
    {lat: 53.2194, lon: 6.5665, place: "Groningen, Netherlands", type: "talk",
     events: ["2025 — 16th Input–Output Workshop"]},
    {lat: 50.7544, lon: 16.2019, place: "Boguszów-Gorce, Poland", type: "talk",
     events: ["2023 — EKO DOK Conference"]},
    {lat: 45.6594, lon: 10.0489, place: "Iseo, Italy", type: "visit",
     events: ["2026 — Summer School: The New Global Economic Order",
              "2024 — Summer School: The World Economy's Shifting Winds"]},
    {lat: 46.0569, lon: 14.5058, place: "Ljubljana, Slovenia", type: "visit",
     events: ["2025 — HydRoData Summer School"]},
    {lat: 52.0864, lon: 21.1189, place: "Konstancin-Jeziorna, Poland", type: "visit",
     events: ["2023 — Summer School for Young Economists from the Three Seas Region"]},
    {lat: 38.8997, lon: -77.0489, place: "Washington, D.C., United States", type: "visit",
     events: ["2026 — Research visit, George Washington University"]},
    {lat: 63.8258, lon: 20.2630, place: "Umeå, Sweden", type: "visit",
     events: ["2026 — Research visit, Umeå School of Business, Economics and Statistics"]},
    {lat: 43.4723, lon: -80.5449, place: "Waterloo, Ontario, Canada", type: "visit",
     events: ["2026 — Research visit, University of Waterloo Water Institute"]}
  ];

  const map = L.map('talkmap', {scrollWheelZoom: false, zoomControl: true});

  // Podkład: jasnoszary Esri Light Gray Canvas — bez klucza API.
  // Jeśli kafelki nie odpowiedzą, skrypt sam przełącza się na
  // OpenStreetMap i nakłada filtr szarości (klasa .talkmap--osm).
  const esriBase = L.tileLayer(
    'https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/Canvas/World_Light_Gray_Base/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}',
    {attribution: '&copy; Esri, HERE, Garmin, &copy; OpenStreetMap contributors', maxZoom: 16});

  const esriLabels = L.tileLayer(
    'https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/Canvas/World_Light_Gray_Reference/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}',
    {maxZoom: 16, pane: 'shadowPane'});

  esriBase.addTo(map);
  esriLabels.addTo(map);

  let switched = false;
  esriBase.on('tileerror', function () {
    if (switched) return;
    switched = true;
    map.removeLayer(esriBase);
    map.removeLayer(esriLabels);
    document.getElementById('talkmap').classList.add('talkmap--osm');
    L.tileLayer('https://tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png', {
      attribution: '&copy; OpenStreetMap contributors',
      maxZoom: 19
    }).addTo(map);
  });

  const bounds = [];
  stops.forEach(function (s) {
    bounds.push([s.lat, s.lon]);
    const talk = s.type === 'talk';
    L.circleMarker([s.lat, s.lon], {
      radius: 7,
      weight: 2,
      color: '#8a7521',
      fillColor: talk ? '#8a7521' : '#ffffff',
      fillOpacity: talk ? 0.45 : 0.95
    }).addTo(map)
      .bindPopup('<strong>' + s.place + '</strong><br>' + s.events.join('<br>'));
  });
  map.fitBounds(bounds, {padding: [40, 40]});
})();
</script>
